_comment: Video bounds for the rankings series only -- kept separate from config/countries.json's global 'video' block and config/comparison_video.json, same reasoning as comparison's own file. Target is 60-70s (portrait Top-8 countdown), widened to 58-78s per this project's standing rule (see feedback memory: widen the cap for natural-paced narration rather than speeding up the TTS voice) -- a Top-8 countdown (intro + 8 rows + outro = 10 beats) at ~2.3 words/sec needs room to breathe without a mid-sentence cut. 2026-10-13: the cloned voice reads this numbers-heavy narration at ~1.45 words/sec (172 words took 116 s), not 2.3 -- the old target produced 96-116 s of voice against the 78 s cap, so the assembler cut off the top ranks and the call-to-action on 4 of 7 runs. words_per_second now matches the real voice (so GPT is asked for ~84-130 words) and the cap is 90 s. The upper bound intentionally runs past the classic 60s YouTube Shorts ceiling into the up-to-3-minute allowance now supported on YouTube/TikTok/Reels, since the user's brief explicitly asked for 60-70s.
